body:
Thanks,

Would it be possible to integrate the widget with instantsearch or do we
have to roll our complete own UI?
Do you know about any other projects who have do it, that could share their
experience?

On Mon, Oct 3, 2016 at 8:35 AM, Alex S notifications@github.com wrote:

> Hi @ahennie https://github.com/ahennie
> It's not possible with dynamic facets (computed from the result set by the
> Algolia engine). However if you've extracted the facets on your side, it
> should be possible to create a custom widget for that. This widget could
> have the knowledge of all the facets that are in the dataset, and if the
> engine doesn't return a value, it will set the count to 0. The only
> drawback is that any new value for the facet mean an update in the frontend.
> 
> Would that fit your need?
>
